title: GMT basic_walk native-window numeric audit
summary: A bounded data-only analysis compared all 64,239 basic_walk windows spanning 18 to 74 native frame intervals and retained three fixed nondominated reference-fitness tradeoffs. The results concern numeric reference shape and seams only, not controller feasibility or task success.

findings.title: Full basic_walk has substantial local yaw rate
findings.statement: The full basic_walk reference has mean and mean-absolute local yaw rate 0.460312 and 0.476757 rad/s, mean local forward speed 0.784646 m/s, forward-speed MAE 0.160138 m/s to 0.7 m/s, and mean absolute lateral speed 0.096336 m/s.
findings.locator: Audit section Three retained numeric candidates, paragraph after first table

findings.title: Three fixed nondominated native-frame windows
findings.statement: Among 64,239 enumerated 18 to 74 interval windows, the fixed retained rows are balanced cycle 1118:1151, minimum-net-yaw cycle 1119:1148, and phase-zero entry control 0:18. They are nondominated over twelve numeric objectives but are not ranked against policy evaluation.
findings.locator: Audit Method and Three retained numeric candidates

findings.title: Late cycles improve loop shape but worsen entry velocity seams
findings.statement: Frames 1118 and 1119 lie outside the current 0 to 15 s phase-matching pool and have measured local-velocity entry jumps 0.620910 and 0.624061 m/s, versus 0.366509 m/s for phase zero. A silent crop replacement would not preserve the current entry condition.

findings.title: Configured crop times must use runtime float32 FPS
findings.statement: Bounds formed with runtime float32 FPS land on the intended integer frame coordinates; supplied-float64 reporting times do not always do so. Recomputed runtime/native seam metrics differ by at most 2.384185791015625e-7 across the three fixed rows.
findings.locator: Audit section Supplied time versus configured runtime time

findings.title: Native crop audit is numeric fitness, not dynamics evidence
findings.statement: The audit used no simulator, actor, dynamics, contact, stability, task-success, or policy-evaluation result. Any later oracle-only revision must declare its entry treatment and run separate dynamics and evaluator gates.

not_evidence_for: contact, stability, path, or learned-task success
